issues.legal_issue: The bar on civil-court jurisdiction under Section 154(1)(e) applies only when a claim for imperfect partition is maintainable under Section 97.
A civil court may determine the parties’ title and shares in revenue-paying property and direct the revenue authority to effect the actual partition.
A dispute concerning title or possession between co-sharers falls within the civil court’s jurisdiction, even when revenue authorities cannot proceed with partition absent their consent.
